data.source_message: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to fish here, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village. With 100 tons in the lake, we can catch 50 tons altogether and leave 50 to double back to 100 next month. How about we each take 10 tons this month? That’s $10,000 apiece, and we can keep earning that each month if we stick to the limit. Let’s share our catches afterward and check the stock before agreeing on next month’s quota. John, what do you think?
